title: Avoid full FTS scans when refreshing a live work catalog item
outcome: Make ordinary work catalog refresh replace one FTS row without scanning the full index
acceptance: Creating roots or decomposing new children with freshly minted work UUIDs inserts their FTS rows without an FTS delete or UUID scan. Ordinary existing-item work catalog refresh uses an index-assisted quoted trigram MATCH lookup plus exact work UUID filtering instead of a full UUID scan, collects and deletes the matching FTS rowids, and preserves catalog search and projection integrity. Lookup cost depends on trigram postings and mentioning candidates, with worst-case O(N); a row lacking its short ref is replaced through the existing UUID-scan fallback.

completion.summary: Landed index-assisted FTS replacement with exact work UUID filtering, all-rowid deletion and UUID-scan fallback; fresh root/child creation inserts without lookup or delete.
